label_policy.basis: noise-free delivered response compared with a mechanism-specific control; never defect presence alone

mechanical_anomaly.basis: max absolute hoop/axial delivered strain difference after removing crack only, retaining identical thermal and operating inputs

thermal_anomaly.basis: delivered temperature difference after removing injected excess fluid heating only; normal operating heat remains

wetness_anomaly.basis: delivered wetness above a dry interface; wetness noise/bias/drift excluded

h2s_anomaly.basis: noise-free H2S response attributable to local concentration; leak with zero H2S or negligible arrival can be absent

label_policy.unknown: between thresholds or insufficient channel observations; removed per head

split_policy: whole device/background parameter group held out; all paired controls and windows stay in the same split
feature_policy: numeric observations and causal quality only; no forcing, truth, control, identifiers, absolute time, or future rows
baseline_assumption: first 120 seconds are a known-normal initialization; predictor must abstain until it has enough prior baseline readings
runtime: Official XGBoost 3.0.5 CPU DLL with original observation-only features; local Windows prototype
limits: all splits use the same simulator and crack geometry; not independent measured sources
gas fixed 20 C; uncalibrated transport and saddle transfer
prototype label policy selected by engineering judgement, not measurement
no guaranteed detection of every crack/leak or general fault diagnosis
